title: Stay away from this piece of junk
text: Stay away from this piece of junk. Got clogged after a few months. Tried to fix it, but they use some weird screws so I couldn't open it. If this is deliberate to make people get a new coffee maker, I will do it, just not this brand.

product_metadata.title: Mr. Coffee 12-Cup Programmable Coffee Maker, Bundle with 1 Month Water Filtration
features: Water filtration helps remove up to 97% of chlorine for better tasting coffee
